name: Atrix 4G

Launch.Announced / released: US: February 22, 2011, CAN: March 17, 2011, KOR: April 3, 2011, UK: May 4, 2011
Launch.Successor: Atrix 2, Atrix HD, Atrix HD LTE

Body.Other: Android WebKit with Adobe Flash Player, Mozilla Firefox 3.6.13 in Webtop Application, eCompass, aGPS with Google Maps, Google Street View, Google Latitude, Android Market

Memory.Storage: 16 GB on board, supports up to 32 GB microSDHC, total 48 GB

Display.Display: 4.0-inch 960×540 px qHD TFT LCD at 275 ppi, 16 M colors, Gorilla Glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 MP AF, digital zoom with LED Flash , Capture – 720p MPEG4 and H.264 at 30 frame/s (full 1080p to be supported via software upgrade post-launch)
Cameras.Front camera: 0.3 MP VGA imager for video chat, self image capture

Battery.Battery: 1930 mAh, Talk time, WCDMA = 9 hrs, GSM = 8.8 hrs, Standby time, WCDMA = 350 hrs, GSM = 400 hrs

Connectivity.Connectivity: WiFi 2.4, 5 GHz 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth 2.1 EDR, WCDMA 850/1900/2100 MHz , GSM 850/900/1800/1900 MHz , HSPA+ at 14.4 Mbit/s , audio jack 3.5 mm , Micro USB 2.0 HS
